sources.description: Developer release post; advertised 0.7.8c feature families, not runtime validation.
Developer-linked 0.7.8c change log; fixes are experiment leads, not current defects.
March 2022 developer replies; historical custom-character and campaign priorities.
Mod author describes replacing game data and sound files; not an official current pack API.

features.title: Twelve-seat battles
acceptance: Complete a full room with stable player/input ownership.
Keep faithful profile limits separate.

features.title: Quick/local/online entry
acceptance: Record each entry flow and its settings ownership.
Test cancellation, rematch and mixed local/remote participants where supported.

features.title: Survival Battle
acceptance: Measure elimination, draw and simultaneous final-hit outcomes.
Retain native regression cases before adding other modes.

features.title: Reversi Battle
acceptance: Observe tile scoring and tie/timeout rules in pinned runs.
Implement through the shared mode interface and expose bot objectives.

features.title: Dodge Battle
acceptance: Measure hazard scheduling and result conditions before implementation.
Split a bounded implementation issue with recorded cases.

features.title: Hyper Bomber
acceptance: Record objective state transitions and simultaneous completion.
Define observed bot-visible objectives separately from hidden state.

features.title: King Battle
acceptance: Measure objective ownership, transfer and round end.
Include equal-time and disconnect cases in the proposed implementation contract.

features.title: Battle Royale
acceptance: Identify exact semantics instead of inferring them from the mode name.
Record scoring, respawn if any, team settings and termination.

features.title: Score progression
acceptance: Inventory level/progression, failure and persistence rules.
Separate these observations from the Saturn campaign.

features.title: Turbo variation
acceptance: Measure which rules change relative to the ordinary score profile.
Keep variant settings explicit and replayable.

features.title: Items and configurable selection
acceptance: Catalogue interactions, precedence and availability by mode.
Use controlled pairs before combinatorial sampling.

features.title: Battle settings and timing
acceptance: Inventory values, defaults, units and persistence.
Probe boundary and simultaneous-event cases without guessing timebases.

features.title: Character roster and unlock behaviour
acceptance: Inventory animation/capability metadata and provenance separately from counts.
Document the intentional Neptune choice to avoid mandatory custom-character unlocks.

features.title: Stages and variants
acceptance: Identify geometry, hazards, collision and spawn semantics separately from art.
Track unknown inventory size and distinct variants rather than PNG totals.

features.title: Self-hosted reference server
acceptance: Pin matching client/server builds and demonstrate an owned local match.
Do not infer protocol compatibility or server internals from availability.

features.title: Community style replacement
acceptance: Inspect the selected build and distinguish replacement mods from supported authoring APIs.
Record tool/version and online compatibility limits.

features.title: Current custom map/character workflow
acceptance: Test current creation/import/sharing with a controlled original asset.
Do not treat historical priorities as current missing-feature proof.

features.title: Online interaction regression leads
acceptance: Test health, status, wrap and thrown-bomb combinations in the current reference.
Treat changelog fixes as test seeds, not unresolved bug claims.

features.title: Saturn campaign
acceptance: Pin release/region and reproduce one room including progression.
Expand enemies, bosses and transitions with explicit missing coverage.

features.title: Saturn battle rules
acceptance: Reproduce one battle arena from controlled reference input.
Detect an intentional movement or fuse regression.

features.title: Saturn graphics recovery
acceptance: Recover raw graphics, palettes, composition and timings with provenance.
Separate forced-state discovery from normal animation order.

features.title: Faithful Saturn CPU opponents
acceptance: Measure policies by mode and difficulty.
Keep enhanced bots separate from fidelity claims.

features.title: Durable issue-to-PR factory
acceptance: Complete a bounded real job with independent exact-head checks.
Recover leases and spend accounting after restart.

features.title: Explicit ruleset profiles
acceptance: Version settings, capabilities and replay identity.
Prevent mode-switch leakage into faithful defaults.

features.title: Online bot room filling
acceptance: Fill rooms and replace bot seats at the declared boundary.
Preserve observation fairness and participant identity.

features.title: Held-out bot tournaments
acceptance: Measure safety, objective competence and tick cost.
Keep held-out maps/seeds and prior policy rollback.

features.title: Browser/native cross-play
acceptance: Complete a mixed-client match on shared authoritative rules.
Exercise direct and relayed connections plus reconnect.

features.title: Measured netplay improvements
acceptance: Compare raw responsiveness and correctness under equivalent conditions.
Publish uncertainty and failed cases before claiming superiority.

features.title: Portable community packs
acceptance: Validate immutable versions and simulation capabilities on both clients.
Reject executable content and mismatched gameplay hashes.

features.title: Unrestricted compatible character selection
acceptance: Select installed compatible characters without compulsory unlocks.
Separate cosmetic selection from gameplay ability capabilities.

features.title: Map and character authoring tools
acceptance: Create an original pack from a template with live validation.
Preview and test with bots before publishing.

features.title: Community workshop and subscriptions
acceptance: Upload, validate, publish and share an immutable pack version.
Join the same version from browser and desktop with clear errors.

features.title: Trusted event-based statistics
acceptance: Rebuild aggregates without duplicate events.
Separate mode, ruleset, human/bot and custom/ranked results.

features.title: Profiles and community features
acceptance: Show identity, creator attribution and confirmed match history.
Provide accessible controls and privacy/moderation flows.

features.title: Accessible scalable interface
acceptance: Support large text/DPI, keyboard navigation and clear player identification.
Keep important state legible without colour-only cues.

features.title: Buildable open-source release
acceptance: Preserve licences/notices and publish reproducible source instructions.
Build with permitted content and exclude unverified reference media.
